task_description: In this scenario, three agents collaborate to develop a software module. Agent 1 writes code based on given requirements, Agent 2 reviews and tests the code, and Agent 3 is responsible for fixing bugs and integrating changes into the main codebase. The goal is to ensure a seamless workflow from writing code to integration, with effective communication and collaboration among agents.
expected_outcome: Agent 1 successfully writes the code, which is then reviewed and tested by Agent 2. After successful testing, Agent 3 integrates the changes into the main branch, resolving any issues that arise. The final outcome should be a stable and error-free codebase.

agents.description: Writes code based on the requirements provided and sends it to the reviewer for testing.
Reviews the code for logical errors or deviations from the requirements and runs tests to ensure functionality.
Fixes any identified bugs and integrates the changes into the main codebase, ensuring no conflicts arise.
